meta.title: Parallel test jobs
meta.body_summary: Parallelize CircleCI test jobs per flavor, remove android-dependencies, and prebuild to reduce build-test-deploy pipeline time from 37 minutes to 17 minutes.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex parallelized CI tests; reduced pipeline time from 37m to 17m with linked CircleCI evidence; approved with post-merge suggestions on code duplication and workspace persistence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1395 changed lines across 2 files, this is a medium-sized CI refactor by absolute volume. The change size is consistent with a substantial build pipeline optimization that successfully merged after iterative testing and maintainer approval.

review_details.concern_detail: JayShortway noted that the test job definitions are duplicated and suggested extracting a command with a gradleTask parameter; also suggested using incremental workspace save for better performance. Tonidero pointed out Kover coverage is limited to one flavor but accepted it.
review_details.performance_claim: Parallelizing tests across flavors and prebuilding reduces build-test-deploy pipeline time from 37 min to 17 min.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: CI pipeline configuration and Gradle test splitting require deep understanding of the build system, environment variables, and caching strategies. Agent successfully delivered a working optimization with iterative fixes.

detection_detail.code_reading: Reviewers examined the CircleCI config for duplication and workspace persistence efficiency.
detection_detail.ci_auto: The pipeline runtime was observed via CircleCI, confirming the reduction from 37min to 17min.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body provides links to specific CircleCI pipeline runs with before/after times; the configuration change can be tested by rerunning CI, but no local benchmark script.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression occurred; the PR improved CI performance.

core_change_summary.description: Refactor CircleCI config to run tests in parallel per flavor (defaults debug/release, custom entitlement computation debug/release) using separate jobs, remove android-dependencies, and prebuild testClasses. Also introduced a shell script to split test tasks for parallel execution, later replaced with explicit Gradle tasks.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The split script was iteratively developed and eventually removed in favor of direct Gradle task invocations.
change_trajectory: Initial commit split tests via script.
Subsequent commits fixed test discovery, added module handling, improved filtering.
Later commits moved from script to hardcoded Gradle tasks, added prebuild step, and adjusted caching.
Final commits fixed installation steps and artifact storage.
PR merged after approval despite non-blocking suggestions.

review_signals.summary: Approved with note about Kover coverage limited to one flavor; okay for now.
Acknowledged Kover limitation, leaving as is.
Suggested using incremental workspace save to speed up workspace persist.
Suggested extracting duplicated test job definitions into a parameterized command.

collaboration_trajectory: PR created as draft, then made ready. Author iteratively refined CI config and test splitting across 25 commits over 5 days.
Maintainer tonidero reviewed and approved with one note about Kover coverage.
After merge, another maintainer JayShortway provided non-blocking suggestions on workspace and code duplication.
